observations.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced EUR 50 million in dedicated funding and accelerated timelines for an existing EU-mandated Black Sea maritime security hub after deadly cargo-ship drone incidents near NATO members. This is a new announced institutional protective commitment, not proof of actual disbursement, operational deployment, attribution of specific attacks, or imminent NATO-Russia conflict. Reuters reports Romania requests forensic evidence for individual attack attribution; Moscow denies involvement.
observations.title: EU pledges EUR 50 million to accelerate Bulgaria-Romania Black Sea maritime security hub
